shortDescription: Brazilian pulp and paper producer Klabin BMFBOVESPA:KLBN3 has suspended operations at its Otacilio Costa plant, in southern Brazil, after a boiler incident left 10 employees injured, according to a securities filing on Wednesday.

children: Brazilian pulp and paper producer Klabin
has suspended operations at its Otacilio Costa plant, in southern Brazil, after a boiler incident left 10 employees injured, according to a securities filing on Wednesday.
Local news outlet G1 said a boiler exploded in the factory, which is located in Santa Catarina state
Klabin said the employees were taken to nearby hospitals
